simple.meaning: מָגֵן (mâgên) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector ; also the scaly hide of the crocodile.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 63 times across Genesis, Deuteronomy, Judges, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, and 13 more, beginning at Genesis 15:1. Its contexts include mountain, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָגֵן (H4043).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מָגֵן (mâgên) / H4043 is traced through Genesis 15:1, Deuteronomy 33:29, Judges 5:8, 2 Samuel 1:21 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.full: H4043. magen or meginnah מָגֵן noun masculine 1Kin 14:27 , & feminine 10:17 , shield (Arabic , Aramaic מְגִנָּא , ) — מָגֵן Gen 15:1 33t. (also construct Deut 33:29 ; Nahum 2:4 ); suffix מָגִנִּי Psa 7:11 5 t.; מָגִנֵּנוּ 33:20 3 t.; מָגִנָּם 115:9 ; 115:10 ; 115:11 ; plural מָגִנִּים 1Kin 10:17 6 t.; מָגִנּוֺת 2Chr 23:9 ; construct מָגִנֵּי 1Kin 14:26 4 t.; suffix מָגִנָּיו Job 15:26 ; מָגִנֶּיהָ Hosea 4:18 ; — shield, buckler , carried by warrior for defence Judg 5:8 ; 2Sam 1:21 (twice in verse); 2Kin 19:32 = Isa 37:33 , 1Chr 5:18 ; 14:7 ; 17:17 ; 23:9 ; 26:14 ; 1Chron 32:5; Neh 4:10 ; Psa 76:4 ; Jer 46:3 , 9 ; Ezek 23:24 ; 38:4-5 , 39:9 ; Nahum 2:4 ; Isa 22:6 ; compare 21:5 (anoint the shield, to make it slippery), so also Psa 35:2 (where ׳י figurative as warrior); מָגֵן אִישׁ = armed man Prov 6:11 ; 24:34 ; laid up for show, or as treasure 1Kin 10:17 (twice in verse); 14:26-27 , (= 2Chr 9:16 (twice in verse); 12:9-10 ,) 32:27 compare Song 4:4 ; Ezek 27:10 ; of scales of crocodile (leviathan) מָגִנִּים אֲפִיקֵי Job 41:7 ; figurative of wicked's defence against judgments of מָגִנָּיו גַבֵּי עֲבִי ׳י, 15:26 ; fig, of king Psa 89:19 (compare Che); figurative of rulers of Ephraim Hosea 4:18 ; figurative of rulers of earth Psalm 47:10; figurative (very often) of ׳י , as defence of his servants, Psa 3:4 ; 7:11 (read אל עָלַי ׳מָגִנִּי compare Che critical note) 18:3 ; 18:31 ; 18:36 (= 2Sam 22:3 , 31 , 36 ) Psa 28:7 ; 33:20 ; 59:12 ; 84:10 ; 84:12 ; 115:9 ; 115:10 ; 115:11 ; 119:114 ; 144:2 ; Prov 2:7 ; 30:5 , and see especially Gen 15:1 (E).
